digest.component_or_area: MCP secret infrastructure (terraform, cloud-init, deployment scripts)
propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key SSM parameter have no runtime consumers in application code, tests, or services
The secret is produced by terraform (ssm.tf), transported via user_data.sh and fetch-secrets.sh into .env files, but nothing reads the injected variable
Verdict signing was superseded by asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates per ADR 0049, making the HMAC secret obsolete
Removal requires atomic coordination across six tracked files (terraform, cloud-init, fetch script, and three docs) to avoid boot-time failures
Removal eliminates a rotation and provisioning obligation with zero security effect while resolving misleading operator documentation
